title: Wringer gate result
description: gates/NNN_<id>/result.json — one gate's row of the contract. Present only for gates that actually ran: a skipped gate leaves no directory, and a gate interrupted mid-flight leaves its logs but no result, because it never finished.

gate_id.description: The gate's id as declared. A slug: [A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]* up to 64 characters, because it also names the directory.

command.description: The shell command as declared, after redaction.

exit_code.description: The process exit status. Negative when a signal ended it — which is what a timeout looks like.

duration_ms.description: Wall-clock milliseconds from spawn to reap.

timed_out.description: Whether the gate overran its declared timeout and was killed.

stdout_truncated.description: Whether stdout.log was capped. The file says so in its first line when true.

optional.description: Whether a failure here was allowed to leave the run passing.

status.description: passed requires exit_code 0 AND timed_out false.
